data.name: Muhvansh
data.gender_notes: Muhvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muhvansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'muh' (moon) and 'vansh' (boon). The name symbolizes receiving blessings and protection from the moon god, providing a strong connection to the divine. The name Muhvansh carries the meaning “Moon's boon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Muhvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody moon's boon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the moon god, signifying divine blessings and protection.
data.etymology: Muhvansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon's boon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhvansh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mahabharata, Book 3: Vana Parva, Section 268 The name Muhvansh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mention of Muhvansh (Mudgala) in the context of a curse placed on the Panchala king Shikhandi by Bhishma, where Shikhandi's masculinity is taken away and he is made a woman. Bhishma instructs his son Vachanadeva to restore Shikhandi's masculinity using the divine ashes of Muhvansh. These ashes are said to have the power to grant a boon to the one who is sprinkled with them.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vayu Purana, Book 76: Uttara Khanda, Chapter 107 The name Muhvansh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muhvansh (Mudgala) is mentioned as the name of a sage who performed fierce penances to attain divine powers. He is also referred to as a devotee of Lord Shiva and is said to have attained the status of a Maharishi (great sage) in heaven after his death.

The name 'Muhvansh' carries an aura of mystery and excitement, making it an attractive choice for individuals looking to make a statement in these digital spaces.
